segments.speaker: Megan Lee, Account Executive
segments.text:
Hi Aaron,

Thanks for the call. Recapping what I have:

- 48 seats to start
- Measurement package plus calibration services
- Target go-live: May 6
- One production workspace, two sandbox workspaces
- Annual invoice, net 30

I’ll send the order form once you confirm billing contact and PO requirement.

Megan

segments.speaker: Aaron Patel, Director of Operations
segments.text:
Hi Megan,

That matches. Billing contact is Dana Kim, dana.kim@northlineco.com. We do need a PO before payment, but legal can review without it.

Can you make sure the order form shows the services as a separate line? Finance asked for that.

Aaron

segments.speaker: Megan Lee, Account Executive
segments.text:
Yeah, no problem. I’ll split subscription and services.

One question: do you want all 48 seats active on day one, or should I set the first 32 for May 6 and the remaining 16 for June 1? It affects the provisioning note but not much else.

Megan

segments.speaker: Aaron Patel, Director of Operations
segments.text:
Let’s do all 48 on May 6. We may not have every manager trained that week, but we want access available.

Also please include the security addendum you mentioned. Our IT lead is asking for the data retention language.

Aaron

segments.speaker: Megan Lee, Account Executive
segments.text:
Got it. I’ll attach the security addendum and keep the retention language at 18 months.

For the commercial side, the list total is $58,400, but since you and I already landed on $51,200 over messages, I’m going to use that number on the order form and clean up the concession approval in deal desk afterward.

Megan

segments.speaker: Aaron Patel, Director of Operations
segments.text:
Thanks. $51,200 works on our side.

Can you set the initial term to May 6, 2026 through May 5, 2027? Our contracts team gets picky about exact dates.

Aaron

segments.speaker: Megan Lee, Account Executive
segments.text:
Yes, I’ll set those dates.

I’m sending the packet now with:

- Order form for 48 seats
- Services line for $6,000 included in the total
- Annual subscription line
- Security addendum
- MSA with net 30

If legal redlines today, I can turn comments by tomorrow afternoon.

Megan

segments.speaker: Aaron Patel, Director of Operations
segments.text:
Received. I forwarded it to legal and finance.

One small thing: the invoice should reference Cost Center 4107. If there’s a field for that, please add it before final signature.

Aaron

segments.speaker: Megan Lee, Account Executive
segments.text:
Added Cost Center 4107 in the billing notes and updated the PDF. Same commercial terms, just that field added.

I’ll wait for legal comments.

Megan

segments.speaker: Aaron Patel, Director of Operations
segments.text:
Legal is fine with the MSA as-is. Finance approved the PO request this morning.

If you send the final signature packet to me and Dana, I can sign today and she’ll attach PO-77294 afterward.

Aaron
